title: Constitutional time: who binds whom in the data on constitutions — companion repository
description: Companion repository for a manuscript under double-blind review (venue withheld). Contains: the 44 Seshat CrisisDB crises with constitutional change and their case descriptions (Polaris-2026 release, CC BY-NC-SA); a single-coder pilot classification of those cases by break type and access direction, with a reading note per case (not validated; published so that it can be independently re-coded); Python scripts that recompute the event counts and Figure 1 from the Comparative Constitutions Project Chronology v6.0 and Table 3 from the pilot; the figures; and the anonymised manuscript as submitted. Nothing in the article is claimed as executed except the pilot, with its status.
